title: Sign in with an injected test session
Chat with May and get a reply
goal: In May Playground, on the Chats screen, open the chat named {tag} chat, made for this test; do not open the chat named May or any other chat, and do not use the + button. Tap the message field at the bottom. Send this message: This is device test {tag}. Reply with the word received. Then wait until May's reply is posted under your message.

title: Add a note to a new agenda task
goal: In May Playground, tap the Agenda tab in the bottom bar (not a chat). Do not open any existing task; create a new one. Add a new task titled {tag} task, then open that task. On its Details tab, tap the notes field that says Add notes and type: {tag} note from the device test. Then go back, open the {tag} task again and check that the note is shown on it, then delete the {tag} task.

title: Answer May's multiple-choice question
goal: In May Playground, on the Chats screen, open the chat named {tag} chat, made for this test; do not open the chat named May or any other chat, and do not use the + button. Send this message: Ask me one multiple-choice question about which fruit I would like as a snack, with three choices, tag {tag}. When May shows a question card with choices, tap one of the choices. Then wait until that card shows your choice as the answer.

title: Skip May's question with a free reply
goal: In May Playground, on the Chats screen, open the chat named {tag} chat, made for this test; do not open the chat named May or any other chat, and do not use the + button. Send this message: Ask me one multiple-choice question about which fruit I would like as a snack, with three choices, tag {tag}. When May shows a question card with choices, do not tap any choice. Instead type and send this message: I will answer myself: apples, {tag}. Then check that the same question card now shows as skipped, with its choices dimmed.

title: Make a routine from chat
goal: In May Playground, on the Chats screen, open the chat named {tag} chat, made for this test; do not open the chat named May or any other chat, and do not use the + button. Send this message: Make a daily routine called {tag} stretch that reminds me to stretch at 9am. When May shows a question card asking whether to create the routine, tap Create it. Then wait until May confirms the routine is made.

title: Go through onboarding on a new account
goal: May Playground has just signed in to a new account for device test {tag} and shows its first-run onboarding. Go through it: on Hi, I'm May tap Accept and continue; on the email step and on the phone step tap Not now, never making an address or getting a number; on I have my own computer tap Continue; on Connect your apps tap Not now, never connecting an app; on Make me yours tap Purple, then Continue; on Let me reach you tap Not now, never turning on notifications; on I'm all set, tap Start chatting. Do not type anything or change a setting. You are done, and must stop at once and report success, as soon as you have tapped Not now on Let me reach you, or as soon as the app's main tabs (Chats, Agenda) show, whichever comes first.

title: Harness smoke check: the app starts signed out and the agent can see it
goal: May Playground has just started, signed out. Take one screenshot and read the hierarchy. Do not tap, type, swipe or go back. Then call done with outcome completed, and in the summary name the screen you see.
